selection_rule: Select XGBoost only if it improves cross-validation ROC-AUC, average precision, and Brier score
recalibration_reason: Observed calibration differences are small, and high-probability bins have limited sample sizes
limitations: Selection uses three stratified cross-validation folds
Equal-width expected calibration error depends on binning
Sparse high-risk bins have uncertain observed rates
No temporal validation is possible with available dates
